title: I. Riana and the Illuminous Triangles

legend: Riana always wanted to join the secret order of the ProgVar. Most people doubt its existence, believing it to be just a myth propagated by paranoid conspiracy theorists. However, some, including Riana, know the truth: ProgVar is an immensely influential organization working behind the scenes to control the world at large.

The all-knowing ProgVar, of course, is aware of her intent. One day, she received an initiation parchment. The parchment contains a geometric graph of n$$$n$$$ points, no three of which are collinear. Riana knows that ProgVar is obsessed with triangles, and that she may form a triangle from any three of the n$$$n$$$ points.

To demonstrate her commitment to joining the order, she must count how many ways there are of forming two triangles such that one triangle lies entirely within the other. In particular, these two triangles must not share a vertex. Two ways of forming triangles are considered distinct if there is a point that is used as a triangle vertex in one way but not in the other way.

Riana, of course, is a capable follower, and she sent her answers to the order in less than two seconds. ProgVar, busy with more important world affairs, has outsourced the task of checking her answers to you. How many such ways of forming two triangles are there?
input: The first line contains the number of points n≤300$$$n \leq 300$$$.
The next n$$$n$$$ lines each contains two integers x$$$x$$$ and y$$$y$$$, where the i$$$i$$$th line denotes that the i$$$i$$$th point is (x,y)$$$(x, y)$$$.
The absolute values of the coordinates of each point are guaranteed not to exceed 104$$$10^4$$$.
output: Print how many such ways there are of forming two triangles that satisfy the problem.
Note that the answer may exceed 1010$$$10^{10}$$$.
note: It may also be shown that there are no other pairs of triangles that satisfy the problem conditions. Therefore, the answer for the first test case is 4$$$4$$$.

legend.ai: Riana 一直想加入 ProgVar 的秘密组织。大多数人怀疑它的存在，认为那只是偏执的阴谋论者传播的传说。然而，包括 Riana 在内的一些人知道真相：ProgVar 是一个极具影响力的组织，在幕后运作，掌控着整个世界。
无所不知的 ProgVar 当然知道她的意图。一天，她收到了一份入会羊皮卷。羊皮卷上有一个由 n$$$n$$$ 个点构成的几何图形，其中任意三点不共线。Riana 知道 ProgVar 痴迷于三角形，她可以从这 n$$$n$$$ 个点中任意选取三个点组成一个三角形。
为了证明她对加入组织的决心，她必须统计有多少种方式可以组成两个三角形，使得其中一个三角形完全位于另一个三角形内部。特别地，这两个三角形不能有公共顶点。如果存在一个点在一种方案中被用作三角形顶点，而在另一种方案中没有被用作三角形顶点，则这两种方案视为不同。
Riana 当然是一位能干的追随者，她在不到两秒内就把答案交给了组织。忙于更重要世界事务的 ProgVar 将核对答案的任务外包给了你。这样的方案共有多少种？

input.ai: 第一行包含点的个数 n≤300$$$n \leq 300$$$。
接下来的 n$$$n$$$ 行，每行包含两个整数 x$$$x$$$ 和 y$$$y$$$，其中第 i$$$i$$$ 行表示第 i$$$i$$$ 个点的坐标为 (x,y)$$$(x, y)$$$。
保证每个点的坐标的绝对值不超过 104$$$10^4$$$。

output.ai: 输出构成满足题目条件的两个三角形的方案数。

note.ai: 还可以证明，不存在其他满足题目条件的三角形对。因此，第一个测试用例的答案是 4$$$4$$$。
